    Bloomsbury Theatre & Studio

    Welcome to the Bloomsbury Theatre, a premier destination for theatre shows and comedy in London. Here is the place to discover top acts and immerse yourself in London's vibrant theatre scene. With a variety of upcoming events and shows in our main and studio spaces, the Bloomsbury Theatre offers an unforgettable entertainment experience. Get your tickets for London's best live shows today.

    As the official theatre of Students' Union UCL, we showcase a diverse range of theatre shows, live performances and events, catering to both the public and university community. Don't miss out on our exclusive student discounts and student society shows, offering you a unique experience at unbeatable prices.

    We look forward to welcoming you soon.

    Join our mailing list

    A proud member of UK Theatre, the UK’s leading theatre and performing arts membership organisation.

    Accredited by Licensing SAVI and has achieved a 4.5 Star Rating. Licensing SAVI is part of Police Crime Prevention Initiatives, a not-for-profit organisation owned by the Police Service.

    Awarded Gold in the UCL Green Impact Awards 2025. Green Impact is an accreditation scheme devised by the education charity Students Organising for Sustainability UK.
